object.body:
Hello $data.requesterName,

Your request to $data.operationType.toLowerCase() the account $data.accountName on $data.sourceName was submitted successfully.

To view the status of your request, please go to: ${__global.productUrl}/ui/d/my-requests/account-requests. You'll receive a notification once this request has been completed.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Sent to a requester to confirm that their account request has been submitted successfully.
object.name: Account Request Submitted
object.subject: $data.sourceName – $data.operationType request submitted for $data.accountName
